initiative.title: Data flow robustness
initiative.summary: Make srcly's Data flow mode dependable after the #104-#117 stack: never wrong (per-box status, no proof-less proven edges, dead ends named), never broken (fake-engine outcome shapes, Playwright smoke, stale end to end), then fast (<=10 s cold on visual-notes). Then carry M6, M4, M8, M7, call identity (M5 edits 1-2), Return, anchor extensions and two visual fixes. Graph is primary; ledger is detail.
initiative.next_action: Maintainer approval, then T1 (per-box status in routeGraph) as a PR stacked on the docs PR.

sources.anchor: round 1: primary surface, M5 scope, cold budget, carried milestones
round 2: speed levers, order after core, workspace, upstream
round 3: robust order, corpus, anchor extensions, visuals

claims.statement: The graph is the primary surface; the ledger is a detail opened from a box or edge.
Robust means, in order: never wrong, never broken, fast.
Cold first result <= 10 s on visual-notes app/.
Speed levers: disk cache by programHash, perf-only analysis edits, scoped Program; no warming at scan time; pick by measurement and improve over time.
Carry M4, M6, M7, M8; M6 first after the core.
Drop the investigation workspace and pinned preview; keep view-state Return.
engine/ is srcly's fork for now; analysis edits allowed and recorded for possible backport; byte identity not a goal.
Anchor extensions in scope: file/folder via exports, history, multiple anchors.
Visuals in scope: dark-theme colors and label overlap only.
Python data flow is a separate session; reference only.

conflicts.description: C8 answer mixed 'fork' with 'keep them byte identical'; read as fork now, backport-friendly ledger.

shape.appetite: Program of small stacked revertible PRs; core (E1-E3) first.
shape.problem: Data flow mode works but over-claims proof, has thin failure tests, and is 7x over the cold budget on large apps.
shape.recommended_shape: Honesty before coverage before speed; progressive graph + profile-led analysis perf as the main speed path; scoped Program gated on call identity.
success_moves: Fix honesty in srcly projection ops (no analysis edits) before anything else
Profile before any perf edit (T8 before T10)
Gate the scoped Program on call identity to avoid call-site undercount
Fake engine shapes generated from emitted JSON Schemas
Every perf change must leave fixture proven sets byte-identical

first_proof.question: Can route-graph status be per box from data the engine already emits?
first_proof.artifact: routeGraph on solid-route /records and visual-notes /time-blocks with per-box status and a fixture test
first_proof.decision_rule: If most gaps are unlocated, use occurrence omissions (R14); never inherit the route status.

milestones.title: Never wrong
milestones.outcome: Every box and edge claims only what it proved; every path end is explained.
milestones.proof: Engine fixture tests on solid-route and value-flow-basics; corpus anchors listed in PR bodies.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Projection-only changes; analysis untouched until T4.
milestones.rollback: Revert each ticket PR; contracts re-emitted.

milestones.title: Never broken
milestones.outcome: Every failure is named and regressions are caught before merge.
milestones.proof: Parametrized fake-engine router/client tests; Playwright CI job on solid-route.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Tests only plus fake engine changes; product unchanged.

milestones.title: Fast
milestones.outcome: Cold first result <= 10 s on visual-notes; reopen < 3 s.
milestones.proof: measurements.md rows; byte-identical fixture proven sets.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Each lever behind an SRCLY_DATAFLOW_* switch until measured twice.
milestones.rollback: Turn the switch off or revert.

milestones.proof: two-call-identity-helper and returns-other-argument fixtures; line 88 vs 109.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Older facts without callId keep the one-call-site rule.
